verdict.rationale: Pricing docs confirm Klaviyo ships a 'segmentation' feature alongside contacts/activity data import (klaviyo-docs-11, klaviyo-docs-19), and Composer AI can 'build the audience' from a stated goal (klaviyo-docs-25), implying audience building from data. However, there is no evidence describing segment definition mechanics (attributes, tags, behavioral events) or that segments update live as data changes. Missing for 10: documentation of segment builder UI/logic, explicit mention of tag-based or event-based segment criteria, and confirmation that segments are dynamically recalculated in real time.
